law: Nothing in this file may be started automatically. When MOP stops, the governor marks HEAVY_WINDOW_AVAILABLE and stops. A human decides.
the_only_genuinely_blocked_question: What representation replaces the semantically collapsed sub-bit artifact? Everything else in the campaign has been made to progress without a heavy window; this cannot be.

queue.name: representation escalation, arms A1-A5 on a real small parent
queue.why_first: it answers the blocking question, and it is the cheapest way to answer it. A sub-1B real parent exercises every gate the preregistration froze -- live generation, the 2+2 probe, oracle/runtime parity, cascade -- at a fraction of a flagship's cost.
queue.arms_ready: A1, A2, A3, A4 have serializer, exact byte accounting and deterministic decoder, verified on fixtures. A5 packs but has no decoder yet. A6 is DATA_BLOCKED on trajectory traces.
queue.what_must_not_change: the strict 1.0 complete-BPW ceiling, the gate order, and the rule that weight-space error is inadmissible as promotion evidence
queue.estimated_cost: hours, not days, on a sub-1B parent
queue.deferred_because: LIGHT_ONLY; a real parent load is forbidden while MOP runs

queue.name: A5 decoder plus real importance measurement
queue.why: Math-Preserve already spends 67.5 GB on protected islands and still collapses, so the live question is whether the islands are in the wrong PLACES. That needs importance measured on a real parent, not a synthetic proxy.
queue.deferred_because: needs a real parent forward pass

queue.name: trajectory trace capture, to unblock A6
queue.why: A6 is the arm that directly targets router drift, which the cascade study identified as the failure mechanism. It is DATA_BLOCKED, not failed: the teacher ledger holds 122 lines, 118 per-layer captures and ZERO trajectory traces.
queue.warning: capture from a WORKING parent. Never from Math-Preserve -- it is REFUSED in the capability register and traces from it would teach a student to reproduce the collapse.
